notes: Rev 2.A: first issue of the BEN Engine Rev 2 design set (docs/REV2_DECISION.md) for review — Rev 2 lineup BEN 1 (both forms), BEN 5, BEN 30, BEN 150, BEN 300, BEN 500, BEN 700 and BEN 2000; brand v2 title blocks with the data plate band; liquid-first dense tiers BEN 300 and BEN 700; non-conductive liner on the wall opposite live parts per EN-001. Not for construction until a named checker signs this record and the set is regenerated.

predecessor.note: Rev 1 design set (Rev B issued for construction for BEN 30/150/500/2000, Rev C issued for review for BEN 5). Frozen; see releases/REV1.md and the notices list in design/REVISION.json (EN-001 hold).

change_register.title: New tiers
change_register.summary: BEN 1 indoor mini rack (10-inch 8U desk rack <= 0.6 kW and 19-inch 12U sound-damped cabinet <= 1.5 kW, 120 V plug-in) with a reduced sheet set A-001, E-001, C-001 and the installation sheet I-001; BEN 300 (20 ft, 300 kW, 2 GB300 NVL72-class racks) and BEN 700 (40 ft, 700 kW, 5 racks; renamed from BEN 1000 because 1,000 kW does not fit the 40 ft row with real footprints, interference checks I-D1..I-D19).

change_register.title: Brand v2 title blocks
change_register.summary: Title block per brand/v2/titleblock-spec.md: Deep Cobalt lockup master (lockup-deep.svg) on white paper, Archivo / IBM Plex fonts from brand/v2/fonts/ttf with DejaVu fallbacks, print colour set (Ink / Slate / Fog / Deep Cobalt / Hold), data plate band 'Schreiber AI · BEN Engine · <tier> · Drawing set Rev 2.A · <status> · <date>' under every title block, legal line under the frame. Thermal ramp replaces amber for heat cues.

change_register.title: Liquid-first dense tiers
change_register.summary: BEN 300 / BEN 700: direct liquid W45 loop with row CDUs N+1 (600 kW class), rear-plenum UQD manifolds, row isolation valves closing on leak (leak-to-isolation <= 15 s), residual air on in-row fan coils fed by an 18 C trim loop from the skid chiller (W45 water cannot cool room air: Rev 1 forward line CLG-AIR-RESID-HD at 12 kW on W45 is not used), Galaxy VL UPS frames with lithium battery cabinets as separate NFPA 855 groups, heat-reuse port. CTQ/CTP tables add CDU, manifold, W45 loop, leak-to-isolation and battery-group items.
change_register.reason: docs/REV2_DECISION.md §2 (density); CAPA observation on the W45 fan coil (docs/audit/CAPA_LOG.md)

change_register.title: Non-conductive liner on the wall opposite live parts (EN-001)
change_register.summary: The aisle wall opposite the row is lined with ENV-LINER-NC (Class A, ASTM E84, non-conductive FRP panels on furring with nylon fasteners, no metal trim) instead of the galvanised steel liner ENV-LINER, so the NEC 110.26 condition 1 working space (914 mm at 151-600 V to ground) is justified for the 480 V tiers BEN 150 / 500 / 300 / 700; the fire releasing panel moves to the exterior beside the door and the EPO station into the door-end frame so no grounded device sits in the working space; 480 V gear keeps the condition 2 depth (1,067 mm) conservatively. BEN 30 (208Y/120 V) and BEN 5 / BEN 1 (120 V to ground) need 914 mm under every condition and keep their liners. BEN 2000 aisles are designed to condition 2 / 3.
change_register.requested_by: design authority (finding of the lineup engineer)
